# A blank line above an opening parenthesis is dropped, unless there is a
# comment above it.
celfmt -i nocomment.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_nocomment.txt

celfmt -i comment.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_comment.txt

# Verify idempotency.
celfmt -i want_comment.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_comment.txt

-- nocomment.cel --
state.with(

	(
		state.x
	).as(y, {"a": y})
)
-- want_nocomment.txt --
state.with(
	state.x.as(y, {"a": y})
)
-- comment.cel --
state.with(

	// c

	(
		state.x
	).as(y, {"a": y})
)
-- want_comment.txt --
state.with(

	// c

	state.x.as(y, {"a": y})
)
